# Shubham Dutta

> Shubham Dutta is the founder and CEO of Bortex, a defence-technology
> company in Bengaluru, India, building AI-powered border surveillance and
> tactical awareness systems for the Indian Armed Forces. He holds a BTech in
> Mechanical Engineering from IIT Bombay.

- Role: Founder & CEO, Bortex
- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Education: BTech, Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (2020–2024)
- Focus: Defence technology, autonomous systems, computer vision, EO/IR and thermal imaging, sensor fusion, AR optics
- Website: https://shinobi-hub.github.io
- Company: https://bortex.co.in

## What Bortex is

Bortex is an Indian defence-technology company incorporated in June 2026 and
headquartered in Bengaluru. It builds AI-powered border observability and
tactical awareness systems. In July 2026 Bortex was incubated at ITI Limited,
a Government of India enterprise, through the Vinyas Startup Hub programme.

Bortex's core technology is the X-Matrix architecture, a sensor-fusion
backbone that ingests camera, radar, acoustic and unmanned-asset data in real
time and fuses it into a single operating picture across air, land and sea.

## Bortex products

All four systems are pre-deployment as of 2026. Status is as published by Bortex.

- [Vanguard](https://bortex.co.in/products/vanguard): Soldier-mounted ruggedised AR glasses overlaying navigation, targeting and squad data onto a soldier's field of view. 60° binocular HUD. Status: R&D, 2027.
- [Perimeter](https://bortex.co.in/products/perimeter): Autonomous solar-augmented border-surveillance towers. 20 km person and 35 km vehicle detection, 14 days off-grid. Status: Ideation, 2027.
- [Trident](https://bortex.co.in/products/trident): Layered AI counter-UAS platform combining RF, radar and EO/IR detection. Under 2 seconds detect-to-classify, Group 1–3 UAS. Status: Ideation, 2027.
- [Vigil](https://bortex.co.in/products/vigil): Multi-domain unmanned surveillance meshing aerial, surface, underwater and ground robots. One operator to 12+ assets. Status: Ideation, 2027.

## Before Bortex

- Co-founder, Vibe — agentic commerce
- Product Lead, Livingthings AI — connected hardware, mechanical design and prototyping
- APM & Reliability Engineer, Paar Autonomy — autonomous systems
- AI supply chain, Zomato
- Femtosecond-laser optics research and terrain-adapting hexapod robots, IIT Bombay
